name: jev-router
description: Asks TypeSafe's Jev how hard each prompt is and picks the Claude model for that turn. Off until you type 'jev on' in a session.

defaultMode.title: Mode that 'jev on' starts
defaultMode.description: report shows the model Jev would pick and changes nothing. apply runs each turn on the picked model.

models.title: Models by difficulty
models.description: Comma-separated, easiest first: the model for difficulty level 0, 1, 2 and 3. Aliases or full model ids. With fewer than four, the last one covers the higher levels.
